description: 高雄市二代戒菸服務機構(田寮區、燕巢區、橋頭區、梓官區、彌陀區、永安區) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 高雄市政府衛生局. 機構名稱、地址、電話、用藥、衛教. Coverage: 高雄市政府衛生局. The portal files it under the publisher 高雄市政府衛生局. Its tags are 就醫. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
